No. The Moon’s altitude is **−31.3°**, meaning it is about 31° below your local horizon, so Earth itself blocks it from view. Clear skies, darkness, illumination, and eyesight cannot overcome that.

You would need to wait until the Moon rises above the horizon; in practice, a few degrees of positive altitude may be needed for an easy unaided-eye sighting because of terrain and atmospheric extinction.
